claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemMechanics.vehicle
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core behavior is not a passive grant, one-shot activation, triggered reaction, or simple composite. It is a persistent controllable vehicle/object with its own stat block, occupancy, sealed compartment, and action-driven control surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: To be used as a vehicle, the apparatus requires one pilot.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: lever_control_surface
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item exposes ten temporary controls whose up/down settings cause state changes, attacks, movement, lighting, vertical movement, and hatch state. Existing activation phases do not model a reusable multi-control dispatch surface over persistent object state.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature in the compartment can take a Utilize action to move as many as two of the apparatus's levers up or down.
